files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added
- Sessions: search field under the "Comment" column header, keeping the sessions whose comment contains all the words typed (ignoring case and accents); combined with the other filters.
- Sessions: "Buddies" column, sortable, with a filter under its header.

### Changed
- Buddies: the link to the sessions with a buddy opens the table filtered on this buddy (filter changeable in the header), like the links from a spot or a piece of equipment.
